name: @w6w-apps/edenai
description: Run LLMs, embeddings, images, speech, OCR, translation, web scraping and 500+ other AI models from many providers through Eden AI's single API.

w6w.longDescription:
Eden AI is an AI gateway: one API key and one request shape reach 500+ models from 50+ providers, with provider fallback, routing and per-call cost reporting built in. This app covers the V3 API in two halves.

The LLM half is OpenAI-compatible: chat completions, the stateful Responses API, embeddings, content moderation, image generation, text-to-speech and video generation. Name a model as provider/model to pin a vendor, or give a bare model name and let Eden AI route by price, speed or latency.

The Universal AI half runs the non-LLM "expert models" - translation, OCR, resume parsing, entity extraction, AI-text detection, PII anonymization, web search and scraping - by naming a feature/subfeature/provider and swapping providers without changing the workflow. Long-running features (multipage OCR, speech-to-text, crawling, deep research) are a start action plus a job-status action. A generic Universal AI action and feature-discovery actions reach every other expert model.
